description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between ambiguity standard deviation and Fleiss Kappa, presented for two distinct maximum ambiguity values. The horizontal axis represents ambiguity standard deviation, labeled “Ambiguity Std” or “Max Ambiguity”, with categories 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94 in the first chart and 1, 2, and 3 in the second chart, displayed in ascending order. The vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.9 with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. In the first chart, there are four teal bars corresponding to the ambiguity standard deviation categories; the bar for 0.0 has a height of approximately 0.88, the bar for 0.47 reaches approximately 0.89, the bar for 0.82 is approximately 0.46, and the bar for 0.94 is approximately 0.23. The second chart also contains four teal bars, with the bar for 1 reaching approximately 0.89, the bar for 2 reaching approximately 0.46, and the bar for 3 reaching approximately 0.23. Each bar is labeled with its corresponding Fleiss Kappa value above its height. No bars are visually emphasized, and the charts are presented side-by-side for comparison.
